articles.summary: MIDLAND, Texas, June 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Viper Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: VNOM) (“Viper”), a subsidiary of Diamondback Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: FANG) (“Diamondback”), today announced that it plans to release second quarter 2026 financial results on August 3, 2026 after the market closes.
articles.title: Viper Energy, Inc., a Subsidiary of Diamondback Energy, Inc., Schedules Second Quarter 2026 Conference Call for August 4, 2026
